thread:
devon: Quick Q — for /v1/usage responses, how should we surface cached vs billed tokens? Clients today expect `prompt_tokens` and `completion_tokens`, but accounting needs the canonical charged amount. If KV cache serves part or all of the completion, how should that show up in the response so downstream recon uses the correct billing? cc @maria @alex

maria: From accounting — we need a single canonical number per request we can use for reconciliation. If possible add a non-ambiguous field that means "what we actually billed the customer". Keep the old fields around for product/telemetry reasons.

alex: Agree with Maria. To avoid breaking clients let's keep `prompt_tokens`/`completion_tokens` but add new fields. Options: flat new ints (e.g. `billed_tokens`, `billed_prompt_tokens`, `billed_completion_tokens`) or a `billing` object. Flat ints are easiest for older parsers.

devon: Working through an example. Current response looks like:

```json
{
  "prompt_tokens": 24,
  "completion_tokens": 120,
  "total_tokens": 144
}
```

If 80 of the completion tokens were served from KV prefix, we only charge for 40 tokens. Proposed non-breaking extension: add `billed_tokens` + per-type billed ints:

```json
{
  "prompt_tokens": 24,
  "completion_tokens": 120,
  "total_tokens": 144,
  "billed_prompt_tokens": 24,
  "billed_completion_tokens": 40,
  "billed_tokens": 64,
  "cached_completion_prefix_tokens": 80
}
```

priya: Product note — prefer one canonical billed field (`billed_tokens`) plus optional breakdowns. Keep the breakdown optional so reconciliation systems can fall back to `billed_tokens` only. Also document how streaming interacts with this (partial cache + streamed tail).

alex: Edge case: streaming where the client reads the cached prefix first and then the model generates the rest mid-stream. We need an integer count for how many completion tokens were served from cache (`cached_completion_prefix_tokens` above). That makes billed math deterministic: `billed_completion = completion_tokens - cached_completion_prefix_tokens` (floor at 0).

maria: Accounting requests one more thing: a request-level boolean isn't sufficient for streaming. Please include explicit integers, and also include `billing_version` so reconciler can detect older responses. Example: `billing_version: "2"` when new fields present.

sasha-bot: Note from CI — PR #424 will add the new fields behind a feature flag `billing_v2`. Tests included for cached prefix + streaming scenarios.

devon: Implementation plan I'm proposing:
- add `billed_tokens` (int) as canonical charged units
- add optional `billed_prompt_tokens`, `billed_completion_tokens` for drill-down
- add `cached_completion_prefix_tokens` (int) when any prefix was served from cache
- add `billing_version` (string)
I'll keep `prompt_tokens`/`completion_tokens` unchanged.

alex: Tech ask — please also add unit tests and a small snippet in the SDKs showing fallback logic: use `billed_tokens` if present, else compute using existing heuristics.

maria: Approved from accounting — we'll switch recon jobs to prefer `billed_tokens` and fallback to the old heuristic if absent. Please include changelog + migration note.

priya: :thumbsup: Add a short note in the API changelog, and plan a 2-week opt-in before we recommend everyone use `billed_tokens`. Also include an example for partial cache + streaming.

devon: I'll draft the PR and add the examples + tests. Tagging @alex & @maria for sign-off when ready.

alex: SG. One last request: include a sample streaming timeline in the docs (timestamps + token counts) so ops and accounting can validate recon results.

maria: Thanks — this should make offline reconciliation much more deterministic.

priya: Will coordinate doc/announce.

sasha-bot: deploy-note: feature-flag `billing_v2` rolled to staging. Remember to add env var `API_BILLING_V2=true` for SDK test runs.
